author: Ifmyante
text:
And about the new course:

Up to now, I've taught all the complexities of the market from the very
start, so that after it's all been digested, one can easily see the
future of price.

Well, I've found that such complexity can be intimidating, and can
actually paralyse the student into not being able to understand any of
it for some time.

So, what I'll do this time is, at the very start of the course, teach
the students how to make profits without knowing all the minutiae of the
 market. Easy setups which will pay nearly every time they're taken.

I feel that if the students are making easy profits from the start, then
 the pressure to learn the finer points will be greatly reduced,
allowing them to digest it faster.

If their understanding of the market lies in the bottom dome of a
sand-timer, the worst thing they can do is try to press it down from the
 top. That just causes a blockage at the neck.

With the new method, they will hardly be paying attention to the timer at all, letting the sands fall as freely as they should.

That, at least, is my great hope for the new class

author: hndrk
text:
I've been thinking about something for a while now, and even though I think If

is already aware of this, I want to put it out there.

If the things you're teaching are worth millions. And you're offering it for 15 K.

Please be very aware that unfortunately there are snakes everywhere.

People who think their desperation warrants terrible acts against other people.

People who can put a smile on your face, while patiently waiting to slowly drive a knive in your heart.

Only asking for 15 K will not weed out the people with bad intentions.

There are people who would kill with a smile from ear to ear for a little bit of money.

Your intentions are very noble and I believe you try to find the best in people.

But thinking that people stay honourable when large sums of money are involved is foolish.

You need to find a way to shield the fund and yourself from bad people only looking to use you.

Thank you for all that you have done to help us, and please don't take this the wrong way.

author: Ifmyante
text:
My mother used to say that I must have a team of gods looking over me, as everything I ever tried turned out perfect.

Well, so far, these gods have sent only truly beautiful people to the
academy. Sure, I'm forever pushing my luck, but it's holding so far

Harsh, you've been giving me tons of advice lately, both on the forum
and privately. It all involves giving you access to the Academy.

Everybody who knows me knows well that any advice I'm given drives me immediately in the opposite direction!

I never ever do what I'm told.

If I knew nothing about the market, and was offered a place in the
Academy for free, I wouldn't take it. The greatest maxim I've ever
learned is

"Love many, trust few, and ALWAYS paddle your own canoe".

I strongly suggest that you stop trying to get more, and focus instead
on solving RTM. A bird in the hand is worth two in the bush

Frankly, I'm surprised we don't already have far more masters than RTM has created. But time will change that!
